bookingFlow.name: Select Service Category
bookingFlow.description: Choose between Auto Care, Garden Care, or Pet Care from your active membership or standalone service menu.

bookingFlow.name: Select Service & Tier
bookingFlow.description: Pick the specific treatment (e.g. Wash + Vacuum, Lawn Mowing, Spa Grooming).

bookingFlow.name: Date & Time Scheduling
bookingFlow.description: Select from available morning (08:00 - 12:00) or afternoon (13:00 - 17:00) concierge arrival slots.

bookingFlow.name: Location & Instructions
bookingFlow.description: Provide estate address, gate access codes, water/power supply locations, and specific preferences.

bookingFlow.name: Coin Redemption / Payment
bookingFlow.description: Apply 1 active service coin from your subscription. Non-subscribers or extra sessions proceed to PayHere secure checkout.

bookingFlow.name: Specialist Dispatch & Tracking
bookingFlow.description: A verified KYC specialist is assigned. You receive real-time SMS/WhatsApp updates and arrival timestamps.

bookingFlow.name: Service Completion & Signature
bookingFlow.description: Digital job card sign-off, before/after photo documentation, and quality review.
